b4af249c6a35124d7d1515fee0f4374a3b30c00a20c4a9ab738eeea75426e7bd - Launcher: This welcome screen introduces Vinyl DEBUG with an image, the title "Vinyl DEBUG," and a descriptive message about the music player. 139c4e1f407f5907bb31f0a76a5e7458db8e879d822279c28c7b210285995fab - Launcher: This screen is an Android permission dialog asking whether Vinyl DEBUG can access photos and media on the device. The current content area shows a list with a "SHUFFLE ALL" item and a song entry titled "Mark Ronson Uptown Funk ft. Bruno…" with secondary text and a menu button. The user can browse tabs, open search, access more options, or interact with listed music items.

c749ba944392fc35c5d48861b2b6f97b11b48cb0f4ffe88570f967ff72373789 - null(Window=null): This is a small popup menu with playlist-related actions. It contains two items: "Shuffle all" and "New playlist." The user can choose to shuffle all songs or start creating a new playlist.

10781987eece1f5059c337907364210892bf87cf29c74f6dca2f61cdb5d9e2b1 - Launcher: This dialog is used to create a new playlist. It shows the title "New playlist," a text input field labeled "Playlist name," and action buttons for "CANCEL" and "CREATE." The user can enter a playlist name and either dismiss or confirm creation.

e9efab97161e3374502d6957125c20287c7465e2cd3dacbfc7d2b7193e7ee138 - Launcher: This popup menu shows actions for a song in the playing queue or player context. The user can choose one of these operations for the selected song.
